title: Mapping the Genome-Wide Polygenic Landscape Across the Developing Connectome
authors: Yoonjung Y. Joo, Bo-Gyeom Kim, Eunji Lee, Jiook Cha et al.
summaryPoints: Analyzed polygenic risk scores across 10,000+ developing brains in the ABCD cohort.
Identified gene-brain convergence nodes in prefrontal and subcortical functional networks.
Revealed distinct structural vs. functional connectome mediation paths for psychiatric vulnerabilities.
significance: Demonstrates the power of population-scale genomic-connectome convergence for computational psychiatry.
labRelevance: Featured major publication from SNU Connectome Lab.
